title: Amazon order history
description: Amazon.com order history imported with amazon-to-sqlite

spend_by_year.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', Order_Date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total_Owed), 2) AS total_spent, COUNT(*) AS items FROM amazon_orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year DESC
spend_by_year.title: Total spend by year

spend_by_month.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Order_Date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total_Owed), 2) AS total_spent, COUNT(*) AS items FROM amazon_orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC
spend_by_month.title: Total spend by month

top_products.sql: SELECT Product_Name, ASIN, COUNT(*) AS times_ordered, ROUND(SUM(Total_Owed), 2) AS total_spent FROM amazon_orders GROUP BY ASIN, Product_Name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 50
top_products.title: Top products by total spend

orders_by_status.sql: SELECT Order_Status, COUNT(*) AS items, ROUND(SUM(Total_Owed), 2) AS total FROM amazon_orders GROUP BY Order_Status ORDER BY items DESC
orders_by_status.title: Orders by status

search_products.sql: SELECT * FROM amazon_orders WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM amazon_orders_fts WHERE amazon_orders_fts MATCH :search) ORDER BY Order_Date DESC
search_products.title: Full-text search product names
